rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for getting better from illness or exhaustion.

example.english: I took a few days off to recuperate, and now I feel better.
example.traditional: 我抖咗幾日，終於好返喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dau2 zo2 gei2 jat6 zung1 jyu1 hou2 faan1 laa3

rows.note: Use this mainly for recovery from an illness, especially in more formal or medical contexts.

example.english: The patient is recovering well after surgery and is expected to recuperate soon enough to leave the hospital.
example.traditional: 病人手術後康復進度理想，預計好快可以出院。
example.jyutping: beng6 jan4 sau2 seot6 hau6 hong1 fuk6 zeon3 dou6 lei5 soeng2 jyu6 gai3 hou2 faai3 ho2 ji5 ceot1 jyun2

rows.note: Use this when recuperation involves deliberately resting and taking time off to regain strength.

example.english: The doctor advised them to take time off work to recuperate.
example.traditional: 醫生建議佢暫停工作，休養一段時間。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 gin3 ji5 keoi5 zaam6 ting4 gung1 zok3 jau1 joeng5 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3
